fields.label: Close
fields.desc: Last adjusted close.

fields.label: Open
fields.desc: Today's adjusted open.

fields.label: High
fields.desc: Today's adjusted high.

fields.label: Low
fields.desc: Today's adjusted low.

fields.label: Volume
fields.desc: Today's traded shares.

fields.label: Return 1D
fields.desc: Price change over 1D (sessions: 1D=1, 1W=5, 1M=21, 3M=63, 6M=126, 12M=252).

fields.label: Return 1W
fields.desc: Price change over 1W (sessions: 1D=1, 1W=5, 1M=21, 3M=63, 6M=126, 12M=252).

fields.label: Return 1M
fields.desc: Price change over 1M (sessions: 1D=1, 1W=5, 1M=21, 3M=63, 6M=126, 12M=252).

fields.label: Return 3M
fields.desc: Price change over 3M (sessions: 1D=1, 1W=5, 1M=21, 3M=63, 6M=126, 12M=252).

fields.label: Return 6M
fields.desc: Price change over 6M (sessions: 1D=1, 1W=5, 1M=21, 3M=63, 6M=126, 12M=252).

fields.label: Return 12M
fields.desc: Price change over 12M (sessions: 1D=1, 1W=5, 1M=21, 3M=63, 6M=126, 12M=252).

fields.label: Avg traded value 20D
fields.desc: Median daily traded value over 20 sessions, in crore rupees. A liquidity filter.

fields.label: ATR % (14D)
fields.desc: 14-day Average True Range as % of price: how much the stock typically moves in a day.

fields.label: History (sessions)
fields.desc: Sessions of price history in the archive for this stock. Low = recent listing.

fields.label: Traded on latest session
fields.desc: 1 if the stock traded on the latest session; 0 if it is stale (suspended or missing).

fields.label: Unadjusted price jump (1Y)
fields.desc: 1 if the adjusted close moved more than -40% or +60% in a single day within the last year: usually a split or bonus missing from the split list (see issues/001). Returns, RS and highs for these stocks are unreliable.

fields.label: Counted in breadth
fields.desc: 1 if the stock passed the breadth data checks on the latest session.

fields.label: 13W high
fields.desc: Highest price over 13W. Useful as a breakout trigger level.

fields.label: 13W high distance
fields.desc: % the close is below the 13W high (0 = at the high). Scan '<= 3' for stocks within 3% of it.

fields.label: 13W high: days since
fields.desc: Sessions since the 13W high was made (0 = today). '<= 5' finds a fresh high.

fields.label: 13W low
fields.desc: Lowest price over 13W. Support / drawdown reference.

fields.label: 13W low distance
fields.desc: % the close is above the 13W low. Large = recovered; small = still near the low.

fields.label: 13W low: days since
fields.desc: Sessions since the 13W low was made (0 = today).

fields.label: 26W high
fields.desc: Highest price over 26W. Useful as a breakout trigger level.

fields.label: 26W high distance
fields.desc: % the close is below the 26W high (0 = at the high). Scan '<= 3' for stocks within 3% of it.

fields.label: 26W high: days since
fields.desc: Sessions since the 26W high was made (0 = today). '<= 5' finds a fresh high.

fields.label: 26W low
fields.desc: Lowest price over 26W. Support / drawdown reference.

fields.label: 26W low distance
fields.desc: % the close is above the 26W low. Large = recovered; small = still near the low.

fields.label: 26W low: days since
fields.desc: Sessions since the 26W low was made (0 = today).

fields.label: 52W high
fields.desc: Highest price over 52W. Useful as a breakout trigger level.

fields.label: 52W high distance

fields.label: 52W high: days since

fields.label: 52W low distance

fields.label: 52W low: days since
fields.desc: Sessions since the 52W low was made (0 = today).

fields.label: 3Y high
fields.desc: Highest price over 3Y (needs enough history). Useful as a breakout trigger level.

fields.label: 3Y high distance
fields.desc: % the close is below the 3Y high (0 = at the high). Scan '<= 3' for stocks within 3% of it.

fields.label: 3Y high: days since
fields.desc: Sessions since the 3Y high was made (0 = today). '<= 5' finds a fresh high.

fields.label: 3Y low
fields.desc: Lowest price over 3Y (needs enough history). Support / drawdown reference.

fields.label: 3Y low distance
fields.desc: % the close is above the 3Y low. Large = recovered; small = still near the low.

fields.label: 3Y low: days since
fields.desc: Sessions since the 3Y low was made (0 = today).

fields.label: 5Y high
fields.desc: Highest price over 5Y (needs enough history). Useful as a breakout trigger level.

fields.label: 5Y high distance
fields.desc: % the close is below the 5Y high (0 = at the high). Scan '<= 3' for stocks within 3% of it.

fields.label: 5Y high: days since

fields.label: 5Y low distance
fields.desc: % the close is above the 5Y low. Large = recovered; small = still near the low.

fields.label: 5Y low: days since
fields.desc: Sessions since the 5Y low was made (0 = today).

fields.label: All-time high
fields.desc: Highest price since the archive starts (2025-01-01). Useful as a breakout trigger level.

fields.label: All-time high distance
fields.desc: % the close is below the All-time high (0 = at the high). Scan '<= 3' for stocks within 3% of it.

fields.label: All-time high: days since
fields.desc: Sessions since the All-time high was made (0 = today). '<= 5' finds a fresh high.

fields.label: All-time low
fields.desc: Lowest price since the archive starts (2025-01-01). Support / drawdown reference.

fields.label: All-time low distance
fields.desc: % the close is above the All-time low. Large = recovered; small = still near the low.

fields.label: All-time low: days since
fields.desc: Sessions since the All-time low was made (0 = today).

fields.label: Position in 52W range
fields.desc: Where the close sits between the 52W low (0) and 52W high (100).

fields.label: Breakout window
fields.desc: 1 when the stock is within 3% of its 52W high, above EMA20 and SMA50, with RSI(14) >= 55: close to breaking out with momentum aligned.

fields.label: Gap at open
fields.desc: Today's open vs the previous close. Large positive = strong overnight demand.

fields.label: Gap up (>= 2%)
fields.desc: 1 if today opened at least 2% above the previous close.

fields.label: Gap down (<= -2%)
fields.desc: 1 if today opened at least 2% below the previous close.

fields.label: New 20-day high
fields.desc: 1 if today's high is the highest of the last 20 sessions.

fields.label: New 20-day low
fields.desc: 1 if today's low is the lowest of the last 20 sessions.

fields.label: New 50-day high
fields.desc: 1 if today's high is the highest of the last 50 sessions.

fields.label: New 50-day low
fields.desc: 1 if today's low is the lowest of the last 50 sessions.

fields.label: SMA 20D
fields.desc: Simple moving average of the close over 20 days.

fields.label: Distance from SMA 20D
fields.desc: % the close is above (+) or below (-) the SMA 20D. Large + = extended; near 0 = retest.

fields.label: SMA 50D
fields.desc: Simple moving average of the close over 50 days.

fields.label: Distance from SMA 50D
fields.desc: % the close is above (+) or below (-) the SMA 50D. Large + = extended; near 0 = retest.

fields.label: SMA 100D
fields.desc: Simple moving average of the close over 100 days.

fields.label: Distance from SMA 100D
fields.desc: % the close is above (+) or below (-) the SMA 100D. Large + = extended; near 0 = retest.

fields.label: SMA 200D
fields.desc: Simple moving average of the close over 200 days.

fields.label: Distance from SMA 200D
fields.desc: % the close is above (+) or below (-) the SMA 200D. Large + = extended; near 0 = retest.

fields.label: SMA 10W
fields.desc: SMA of weekly closes over 10 weeks.

fields.label: Distance from SMA 10W
fields.desc: % the close is above/below the SMA 10W.

fields.label: SMA 21W
fields.desc: SMA of weekly closes over 21 weeks.

fields.label: Distance from SMA 21W
fields.desc: % the close is above/below the SMA 21W.

fields.label: SMA 26W
fields.desc: SMA of weekly closes over 26 weeks.

fields.label: Distance from SMA 26W
fields.desc: % the close is above/below the SMA 26W.

fields.label: SMA 30W
fields.desc: SMA of weekly closes over 30 weeks.

fields.label: Distance from SMA 30W
fields.desc: % the close is above/below the SMA 30W.

fields.label: SMA 40W
fields.desc: SMA of weekly closes over 40 weeks.

fields.label: Distance from SMA 40W
fields.desc: % the close is above/below the SMA 40W.

fields.label: SMA 52W
fields.desc: SMA of weekly closes over 52 weeks.

fields.label: Distance from SMA 52W
fields.desc: % the close is above/below the SMA 52W.

fields.label: SMA 6M
fields.desc: SMA of month-end closes over 6 months.

fields.label: Distance from SMA 6M
fields.desc: % the close is above/below the SMA 6M.

fields.label: SMA 12M
fields.desc: SMA of month-end closes over 12 months.

fields.label: Distance from SMA 12M
fields.desc: % the close is above/below the SMA 12M.

fields.label: EMA 10D
fields.desc: Exponential moving average of the close over 10 days.

fields.label: Distance from EMA 10D
fields.desc: % the close is above (+) or below (-) the EMA 10D. Large + = extended; near 0 = retest.

fields.label: EMA 20D
fields.desc: Exponential moving average of the close over 20 days.

fields.label: Distance from EMA 20D
fields.desc: % the close is above (+) or below (-) the EMA 20D. Large + = extended; near 0 = retest.

fields.label: EMA 50D
fields.desc: Exponential moving average of the close over 50 days.

fields.label: Distance from EMA 50D
fields.desc: % the close is above (+) or below (-) the EMA 50D. Large + = extended; near 0 = retest.

fields.label: EMA 100D
fields.desc: Exponential moving average of the close over 100 days.

fields.label: Distance from EMA 100D
fields.desc: % the close is above (+) or below (-) the EMA 100D. Large + = extended; near 0 = retest.

fields.label: EMA 200D
fields.desc: Exponential moving average of the close over 200 days.

fields.label: Distance from EMA 200D
fields.desc: % the close is above (+) or below (-) the EMA 200D. Large + = extended; near 0 = retest.

fields.label: EMA 10W
fields.desc: EMA of weekly closes over 10 weeks.

fields.label: Distance from EMA 10W
fields.desc: % the close is above/below the EMA 10W.

fields.label: EMA 21W
fields.desc: EMA of weekly closes over 21 weeks.

fields.label: Distance from EMA 21W
fields.desc: % the close is above/below the EMA 21W.

fields.label: EMA 26W
fields.desc: EMA of weekly closes over 26 weeks.

fields.label: Distance from EMA 26W
fields.desc: % the close is above/below the EMA 26W.

fields.label: EMA 30W
fields.desc: EMA of weekly closes over 30 weeks.

fields.label: Distance from EMA 30W
fields.desc: % the close is above/below the EMA 30W.

fields.label: EMA 52W
fields.desc: EMA of weekly closes over 52 weeks.

fields.label: Distance from EMA 52W
fields.desc: % the close is above/below the EMA 52W.

fields.label: EMA 6M
fields.desc: EMA of month-end closes over 6 months.

fields.label: Distance from EMA 6M
fields.desc: % the close is above/below the EMA 6M.

fields.label: EMA 12M
fields.desc: EMA of month-end closes over 12 months.

fields.label: Distance from EMA 12M
fields.desc: % the close is above/below the EMA 12M.

fields.label: MA alignment: bullish
fields.desc: 1 if close > SMA20 > SMA50 > SMA100 > SMA200: cleanly trending up across timeframes.

fields.label: MA alignment: bearish
fields.desc: 1 if close < SMA20 < SMA50 < SMA100 < SMA200.

fields.label: EMA 10 > 20 > 50
fields.desc: 1 if EMA10 > EMA20 > EMA50 (the three lengths the breadth dashboard uses).

fields.label: Close above EMA 10D
fields.desc: 1 if the close is above EMA10.

fields.label: Close above EMA 20D
fields.desc: 1 if the close is above EMA20.

fields.label: Close above EMA 50D
fields.desc: 1 if the close is above EMA50.

fields.label: Close above SMA 200D
fields.desc: 1 if the close is above the 200-day SMA (long-term uptrend).

fields.label: Last golden cross 50D/200D
fields.desc: Periods since the 50D SMA crossed above the 200D SMA. 1 = happened today.

fields.label: Last death cross 50D/200D
fields.desc: Periods since the 50D SMA crossed below the 200D SMA. 1 = happened today.

fields.label: Last golden cross 10W/30W
fields.desc: Weekly bars since the 10W SMA crossed above the 30W SMA. 1 = this week.

fields.label: Last death cross 10W/30W
fields.desc: Weekly bars since the 10W SMA crossed below the 30W SMA. 1 = this week.

fields.label: MACD last change
fields.desc: Sessions since the MACD line last crossed its signal line (either way). 1 = today.

fields.label: MACD bullish cross: periods since
fields.desc: Sessions since MACD last crossed *above* its signal line.

fields.label: MACD bearish cross: periods since
fields.desc: Sessions since MACD last crossed *below* its signal line.

fields.label: EMA10 over EMA20: periods since
fields.desc: Sessions since EMA10 last crossed above EMA20.

fields.label: RSI 14D
fields.desc: Relative Strength Index. > 60 strong momentum, > 70 overbought, < 40 weak, < 30 oversold.

fields.label: RSI 14W
fields.desc: 14-week RSI: sustained multi-month momentum.

fields.label: RSI 12M
fields.desc: 12-month RSI on month-end closes. Needs about 14 months of history.

fields.label: MACD line (12,26)
fields.desc: EMA12 minus EMA26. Above 0 = bullish momentum.

fields.label: MACD signal (9)
fields.desc: 9-day EMA of the MACD line.

fields.label: MACD histogram
fields.desc: MACD line minus signal. Positive = MACD above its signal.

fields.label: MACD above signal
fields.desc: 1 if the MACD line is above its signal line.

fields.label: ADX 14D
fields.desc: Trend strength (not direction). > 25 strong trend, < 20 range-bound.

fields.label: ADX 14W
fields.desc: Weekly trend strength.

fields.label: ADX 12M
fields.desc: Monthly trend strength. Needs about 25 months of history.

fields.label: +DI 14D
fields.desc: Upward directional movement. +DI above -DI = uptrend.

fields.label: -DI 14D
fields.desc: Downward directional movement.

fields.label: Stochastic %K (14)
fields.desc: Where the close is within the last 14 sessions' range. > 80 overbought, < 20 oversold.

fields.label: CRS vs Market (equal-weight) 25D
fields.desc: Comparative relative strength: stock's 25D gain relative to the Market (equal-weight) index, as (1+stock)/(1+index)-1. Positive = outperforming.

fields.label: CRS vs Market (equal-weight) 50D
fields.desc: Comparative relative strength: stock's 50D gain relative to the Market (equal-weight) index, as (1+stock)/(1+index)-1. Positive = outperforming.

fields.label: CRS vs Market (equal-weight) 26W
fields.desc: Comparative relative strength: stock's 26W gain relative to the Market (equal-weight) index, as (1+stock)/(1+index)-1. Positive = outperforming.

fields.label: CRS vs Market (equal-weight) 52W
fields.desc: Comparative relative strength: stock's 52W gain relative to the Market (equal-weight) index, as (1+stock)/(1+index)-1. Positive = outperforming.

fields.label: Return vs Market (equal-weight) 1W
fields.desc: Stock's 1W return minus the Market (equal-weight) index's, in percentage points.

fields.label: Return vs Market (equal-weight) 1M
fields.desc: Stock's 1M return minus the Market (equal-weight) index's, in percentage points.

fields.label: Return vs Market (equal-weight) 3M
fields.desc: Stock's 3M return minus the Market (equal-weight) index's, in percentage points.

fields.label: Return vs Market (equal-weight) 6M
fields.desc: Stock's 6M return minus the Market (equal-weight) index's, in percentage points.

fields.label: Return vs Market (equal-weight) 1Y
fields.desc: Stock's 1Y return minus the Market (equal-weight) index's, in percentage points.

fields.label: CRS vs Largecap (equal-weight) 25D
fields.desc: Comparative relative strength: stock's 25D gain relative to the Largecap (equal-weight) index, as (1+stock)/(1+index)-1. Positive = outperforming.

fields.label: CRS vs Largecap (equal-weight) 50D
fields.desc: Comparative relative strength: stock's 50D gain relative to the Largecap (equal-weight) index, as (1+stock)/(1+index)-1. Positive = outperforming.

fields.label: CRS vs Largecap (equal-weight) 26W
fields.desc: Comparative relative strength: stock's 26W gain relative to the Largecap (equal-weight) index, as (1+stock)/(1+index)-1. Positive = outperforming.

fields.label: CRS vs Largecap (equal-weight) 52W
fields.desc: Comparative relative strength: stock's 52W gain relative to the Largecap (equal-weight) index, as (1+stock)/(1+index)-1. Positive = outperforming.

fields.label: Return vs Largecap (equal-weight) 1W
fields.desc: Stock's 1W return minus the Largecap (equal-weight) index's, in percentage points.

fields.label: Return vs Largecap (equal-weight) 1M
fields.desc: Stock's 1M return minus the Largecap (equal-weight) index's, in percentage points.

fields.label: Return vs Largecap (equal-weight) 3M
fields.desc: Stock's 3M return minus the Largecap (equal-weight) index's, in percentage points.

fields.label: Return vs Largecap (equal-weight) 6M
fields.desc: Stock's 6M return minus the Largecap (equal-weight) index's, in percentage points.

fields.label: Return vs Largecap (equal-weight) 1Y
fields.desc: Stock's 1Y return minus the Largecap (equal-weight) index's, in percentage points.

fields.label: Return vs industry 1W
fields.desc: Stock's 1W return minus the average of its theme group. Positive = a leader within its group.

fields.label: Return vs industry 1M
fields.desc: Stock's 1M return minus the average of its theme group. Positive = a leader within its group.

fields.label: Return vs industry 3M
fields.desc: Stock's 3M return minus the average of its theme group. Positive = a leader within its group.

fields.label: Return vs industry 6M
fields.desc: Stock's 6M return minus the average of its theme group. Positive = a leader within its group.

fields.label: Return vs industry 1Y
fields.desc: Stock's 1Y return minus the average of its theme group. Positive = a leader within its group.

fields.label: RS rating (1-99)
fields.desc: Percentile rank of a weighted 3M/6M/9M/12M return against all stocks in the screen (IBD-style). 80+ = market leader.

fields.label: VSTOP 10D 2x
fields.desc: Volatility stop level: a trailing stop 2x ATR(10) away on D bars. Close above it = uptrend.

fields.label: VSTOP 10D 2x: uptrend
fields.desc: 1 if the close is above the stop (uptrend), 0 if below (downtrend).

fields.label: Last VSTOP 10D 2x change
fields.desc: Bars since the stop last flipped direction. 1 = flipped on the latest bar (fresh signal).

fields.label: VSTOP 14D 2x
fields.desc: Volatility stop level: a trailing stop 2x ATR(14) away on D bars. Close above it = uptrend.

fields.label: VSTOP 14D 2x: uptrend
fields.desc: 1 if the close is above the stop (uptrend), 0 if below (downtrend).

fields.label: Last VSTOP 14D 2x change
fields.desc: Bars since the stop last flipped direction. 1 = flipped on the latest bar (fresh signal).

fields.label: VSTOP 14D 2.5x
fields.desc: Volatility stop level: a trailing stop 2.5x ATR(14) away on D bars. Close above it = uptrend.

fields.label: VSTOP 14D 2.5x: uptrend
fields.desc: 1 if the close is above the stop (uptrend), 0 if below (downtrend).

fields.label: Last VSTOP 14D 2.5x change
fields.desc: Bars since the stop last flipped direction. 1 = flipped on the latest bar (fresh signal).

fields.desc: Volatility stop level: a trailing stop 2x ATR(10) away on W bars. Close above it = uptrend.

fields.label: Last VSTOP 10W 2x change
fields.desc: Bars since the stop last flipped direction. 1 = flipped on the latest bar (fresh signal).

fields.label: VSTOP 14W 2x
fields.desc: Volatility stop level: a trailing stop 2x ATR(14) away on W bars. Close above it = uptrend.

fields.desc: 1 if the close is above the stop (uptrend), 0 if below (downtrend).

fields.label: Last VSTOP 14W 2x change
fields.desc: Bars since the stop last flipped direction. 1 = flipped on the latest bar (fresh signal).

fields.label: VSTOP 14W 2.5x
fields.desc: Volatility stop level: a trailing stop 2.5x ATR(14) away on W bars. Close above it = uptrend.

fields.label: VSTOP 14W 2.5x: uptrend
fields.desc: 1 if the close is above the stop (uptrend), 0 if below (downtrend).

fields.label: Last VSTOP 14W 2.5x change
fields.desc: Bars since the stop last flipped direction. 1 = flipped on the latest bar (fresh signal).

fields.label: VSTOP 10M 2x
fields.desc: Volatility stop level: a trailing stop 2x ATR(10) away on M bars. Close above it = uptrend.

fields.label: VSTOP 10M 2x: uptrend
fields.desc: 1 if the close is above the stop (uptrend), 0 if below (downtrend).

fields.label: Last VSTOP 10M 2x change
fields.desc: Bars since the stop last flipped direction. 1 = flipped on the latest bar (fresh signal).

fields.label: VSTOP 12M 2x
fields.desc: Volatility stop level: a trailing stop 2x ATR(12) away on M bars. Close above it = uptrend.

fields.label: Last VSTOP 12M 2x change
fields.desc: Bars since the stop last flipped direction. 1 = flipped on the latest bar (fresh signal).

fields.label: VSTOP 12M 2.5x
fields.desc: Volatility stop level: a trailing stop 2.5x ATR(12) away on M bars. Close above it = uptrend.

fields.label: VSTOP 12M 2.5x: uptrend

fields.label: Last VSTOP 12M 2.5x change

fields.label: Volume SMA 5D
fields.desc: Average daily shares traded over 5 sessions.

fields.label: Volume SMA 10D
fields.desc: Average daily shares traded over 10 sessions.

fields.label: Volume SMA 20D
fields.desc: Average daily shares traded over 20 sessions.

fields.label: Volume SMA 50D
fields.desc: Average daily shares traded over 50 sessions.

fields.label: Volume SMA 100D
fields.desc: Average daily shares traded over 100 sessions.

fields.label: Volume SMA 200D
fields.desc: Average daily shares traded over 200 sessions.

fields.label: Volume vs SMA 20D
fields.desc: Today's volume divided by the 20-day average (including today). > 2 = volume confirmation.

fields.label: Volume vs SMA 50D
fields.desc: Today's volume divided by the 50-day average.

fields.label: Relative volume
fields.desc: Today's volume divided by the average of the previous 20 sessions (same definition as the Stocks page).

fields.label: Volume dry-up
fields.desc: 1 if the last 5 sessions' average volume is under 60% of the 50-day average: selling interest has dried up.

fields.label: Volume surge on up day
fields.desc: 1 if relative volume >= 2 and the stock closed higher: accumulation.

fields.label: Up/down volume ratio 50D
fields.desc: Volume on up days / volume on down days over 50 sessions. > 1.5 = accumulation.

fields.label: Trend template score (0-8)
fields.desc: Minervini-style checks passed: close > SMA150 & SMA200, SMA150 > SMA200, SMA200 rising, SMA50 > SMA150, close > SMA50, 30%+ above 52W low, within 25% of 52W high.

fields.label: Trend template (all pass)
fields.desc: 1 if all eight trend-template checks pass AND the RS rating is 70 or more.

fields.label: Extension from SMA50 (ATRs)
fields.desc: Distance from the 50D SMA measured in ATRs. > 7-8 = stretched, a pullback is likely.

fields.label: Bollinger bandwidth
fields.desc: Width of the 20,2 Bollinger Bands as % of the middle band: how tight the stock is coiling.

fields.label: Bollinger %B
fields.desc: Position of the close inside the Bollinger Bands (0 = lower band, 1 = upper).

fields.label: Bollinger squeeze
fields.desc: 1 if bandwidth is in the lowest 20% of the last 120 sessions: volatility compression before a move.

fields.label: Narrowest range of 7 (NR7)
fields.desc: 1 if today's high-low range is the smallest of the last 7 sessions.

fields.label: Inside bar
fields.desc: 1 if today's range sits inside yesterday's range.

fields.label: Up/down streak
fields.desc: Consecutive higher closes (positive) or lower closes (negative).

fields.label: Range contraction (5D / 20D)
fields.desc: Average daily range of the last 5 sessions over the last 20. Under 0.6 = a tightening, VCP-like base.

fields.label: Pullback to EMA20 in uptrend
fields.desc: 1 if the stock is in an uptrend (close > SMA50 > SMA200) and today's low touched within 1% of EMA20.
